title: Badge text wraps: "NEW" on Me shows as "NE" / "W" on two lines; text badges do not grow with their text
evidence: harmonyos-home-mate70pro-api21.jpeg, harmonyos-styles-*-*.png (Me tab, all styles)
cause: CYLBadgeView is a child of the icon Stack, which has a fixed width (imageSize, 26 vp); the badge Text is measured inside that width, so long text wraps. iOS (sizeToFit + margin) and Android (wrap_content) size the badge to its label
fix: Host stacks no longer fix their width (tab icon, plus button, demo rows), so the badge is measured with the free width; the badge Text is one line (maxLines 1, no wrap) and its width is the text width + margin, at least its height; the badge width is explicit, as Android CYLBadge.onMeasure / iOS -cyl_adjustLabelWidth: max(height, measured text width (MeasureUtils.measureText, bold) + margin); the border width (twice) is added too, as in PR #801

status: DONE (harmonyos-bundle-image-row-localized.png, emulator 127.0.0.1:5559, 2026-11-16 11:13)
title: The tab bar moves up with the keyboard (it sits right above the keyboard while typing); it must stay fixed at the bottom, in sync with iOS
evidence: harmonyos-emulator-pages-b7fdf26.png (taken on 5559 at 10:37, Home list)
cause: Text not passed through CYLLocalizedString
fix: Synced with iOS, where UIKit never moves the tab bar for the keyboard (it stays at the bottom, covered) and CYLTabBarController+CYLTabBarMinimize.swift treats UIKeyboardWillShowNotification as an interruption that shows a scroll-hidden bar again. HarmonyOS: the controller follows the window's keyboardHeightChange; while the keyboard is up and the avoid mode is not OFFSET, the tab bar container is Visibility.None (out of the layout), so it stays behind the keyboard and the content fills up to the keyboard; it comes back unmoved when the keyboard closes (OFFSET mode already keeps it in place). The keyboard coming up also restores a scroll-hidden bar (cylRestoreFromScroll), as iOS; its going away does not

cause: The badge was "100" with the Bounce animation, an infinite animateTo on translateY; selecting the tab turns it into a dot without animation, and cylPlay() reset translateY by plain assignment, which does not stop a running infinite animation in ArkUI, so it kept driving the dot's transform

title: Tab badges sit at the icon's top-left instead of its top-right since animated tab icons are drawn by CYLAnimatedItemView
evidence: Maintainer report 2026-11-17, verbatim: "鸿蒙系统tabbaritem的badge坐标，预期是右上角现在变左上角了。排查原因" (English: on HarmonyOS the tab bar item's badge should be at the top-right, it is now at the top-left; find the cause). Started with 760dfba2 (22:18), which draws Lottie, Rive and SVGA tab icons with CYLAnimatedItemView(isBare)
cause: CYLAnimatedItemView's root is a Flex without a width, and an ArkUI Flex fills its parent: in the tab item it is as wide as the tab slot, with the icon centred in it, so the tab's icon Stack becomes that wide; the badge is placed at anchorWidth + 2 from the Stack's left edge, which is now left of the centred icon
fix: Core fix in CYLAnimatedItemView (cylanimateditem, published to ohpm), not in the tab bar or the example: a bare item that shows only an icon (no title, no accessory) now has the icon's width and height, so a host can place things against the icon's edges; every other item keeps its default size (`undefined`). Measured with uitest dumpLayout: badge center vs icon top-right dx -96 px before, -10 px after, as the plus button
